description: This Java class defines configuration properties for a COAP adapter, including network configuration paths, cache sizes, thread counts, and regex for ID splitting.

classes.name: CoapAdapterProperties
classes.description: Class representing configurable properties for a COAP adapter, such as network configs, cache sizes, thread counts, and ID split regex.

methods.name: getIdSplitRegex
methods.description: Returns the regex pattern used to split IDs into authority and tenant.

methods.name: setIdSplitRegex
methods.description: Sets the regex pattern used for splitting IDs.

methods.name: getNetworkConfig
methods.description: Returns the path to the network configuration properties file for all CoAP endpoints.

methods.name: setNetworkConfig
methods.description: Sets the path to the network configuration properties file.

methods.name: getSecureNetworkConfig
methods.description: Returns the path to the secure network configuration properties file.

methods.name: setSecureNetworkConfig
methods.description: Sets the path to the secure network configuration properties file.

methods.name: getInsecureNetworkConfig
methods.description: Returns the path to the insecure network configuration properties file.

methods.name: setInsecureNetworkConfig
methods.description: Sets the path to the insecure network configuration properties file.

methods.name: getDeviceCacheMinSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size of the device cache.

methods.name: setDeviceCacheMinSize
methods.description: Sets the minimum size of the device cache.

methods.name: getDeviceCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the device cache.

methods.name: setDeviceCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the device cache.

methods.name: getConnectorThreads
methods.description: Returns the number of connector threads.

methods.name: setConnectorThreads
methods.description: Sets the number of connector threads.

methods.name: getCoapThreads
methods.description: Returns the number of CoAP protocol threads.

methods.name: setCoapThreads
methods.description: Sets the number of CoAP protocol threads.
